notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
Dear friends, we are pleased to inform you that the beta version of PvP multiplayer is now available for play! 

Brief Guide For Multiplayer - https://imgur.com/a/YjbuO0R

We invite you and your friends to play, we will be glad to hear your feedback and your opinion on this update and the game in general, thank you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43249810/d9a7e0daa21f9c931f6e4f4b5148c0364bbafc6a.png

Multiplayer mode can be found in the list of the main game modes

notes.title: RELEASE of Trading Cards, Emoticons & BGs!
notes.notes:
Friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43249810/d9a7e0daa21f9c931f6e4f4b5148c0364bbafc6a.png

Finally Steam approved our trading cards, backgrounds, emoticons and badges.

In total, 5 badges (+1 metal), 15 cards, 10 emoticons and 8 backgrounds were added.


CHECK IT OUT IN POINT SHOP 🐺

More information on trading cards, backgrounds and emoticons - Here 🦊


To get one trading card, you need to spend 15 minutes in the game


We look forward to your feedback in the comments and discussions!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43249810/06e93a2058930139c64bc069fc94e1c71e896752.png

Thank you for your help and support on the way to obtaining these trading cards!
